purpose: Exact existing asset retention list and fixed-source instructions; no new art, native copies or runtime changes.
verificationMethod: SHA-256 over named current files with 8 MiB reads and PNG header dimensions; no recursive asset sweep, Blender launch, render or upload.
gitVerificationOwnership: Parent agent owns checkout HEAD, Git and Graphify bookends.

scope: 128 process artworks with existing IDs and order
original production scripts and historical evidence

standaloneRoofPolicy.sourceGeometryLimitation: existing verified R12 standalone complements and six continuous Jung ceramic meshes; concealed ends are source-generator reconstructions, not newly surveyed evidence

sotdaeulmunDistinction.instruction: Retain its independently approved source from the main asset registry; do not relabel the hyeopmun or shrine-gate natives or invent a new main gate.

estate.placement: original stored world coordinates; rebuilt gates use original assembly matrices
estate.crossLayerLightingLimitation: layers preserve self shadows; cross-layer indirect lighting is not a single-scene path trace

visualInspection.method: view_image of current source images before description; estate display preview was resized by the tool only.
observations: Warm wood, dark tiled roofs, pale stone and plaster, lattice windows and grounded depth are visible in the two building views. Exact structure must come from the asset.
Estate render preserves the compound and courtyard relationships. No numeric bay or column count was inferred.

immutables: Use the exact selected source file and attach it to AI requests. Text prompts alone do not prove identity or geometry.
Preserve object names, membership, hierarchy, origins, transforms, modifiers, custom properties, UV maps and packed textures.
Preserve footprints, surveyed world placement, courtyard and wall layout, dimensions, proportions, silhouette, roof ridge and eave lines, and roof intersections.
Preserve existing column counts, spacing, bays, rafters, beams, stone foundations and steps; never guess numeric counts from a PNG.
Preserve doors, windows, lattice patterns, hinge pivots, opening axes, direction, limits and gate connectivity.
Preserve stage object membership, sequence, process IDs, labels and course-unit links; do not show future completed geometry before the earned stage.
Preserve building-specific material and colour differences rather than imposing a new shared ornamental palette.
Preserve Sarangchae plaques 文獻世家 and 忠孝節義; both appear in connected R16 stage 16.
Keep connected and standalone roofs separate, selected by existing physical connection state with the same process IDs and order.
Left and right hyeopmun and shrine gate are different assets from sotdaeulmun; never substitute them.
Do not recreate retired V1/V2 folders, automatically restore deleted worktrees or automatically promote generated derivatives.
allowedChangesOnlyWhenExplicitlyRequeste: Framing, camera and output size with source comparison and readable detail.
Lighting or material delivery adjustments within the approved identity and the explicitly requested extent; original files stay immutable.
Use locked native scene re-rendering for exact geometry; every new output remains a derivative awaiting review.
authorityLimit: Retain current exact bytes. This inventory authorizes no deletion, generation, upload, commit, push, merge or runtime promotion.
